items.name: lib-utils
items.title: Class name utility
items.description: Merges Tailwind class lists safely, combining conditional class names with tailwind-merge's conflict resolution.

items.name: lib-content
items.title: Block content provider
items.description: Supplies the generic wording every block reads through a React context, so an adopter can override labels, hints and messages from one place without editing block source.

items.name: lib-notice
items.title: Notice banner
items.description: A titled, toned banner (info, warning or success) used for status and recovery messages across the blocks.

items.name: lib-format
items.title: Text and date formatting helpers
items.description: A token-replacing string filler and a long-form date formatter shared by the blocks that render dynamic sentences.

items.name: ui-button
items.title: Button
items.description: A button with the kit's own variant and size set, a 44px minimum touch target, and support for rendering as another element. Adapted from the upstream shadcn button; see NOTICE.md for what changed.

items.name: ui-combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A searchable option list built on base-ui's combobox, with required accessible names added to its trigger, input and list. Adapted from the upstream shadcn combobox; see NOTICE.md for what changed.

items.name: ui-input
items.title: Input and Textarea
items.description: A single-line input and a textarea, both with the kit's 44px minimum height. Predates the CLI-based upstream primitives and is kept as a kit item rather than switched to them; see NOTICE.md. Note: ui-input-group still composes the ui-textarea item, not this item's Textarea export.

items.name: ui-checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox with a lightly rounded indicator. Kept as a kit item because it now differs from the upstream shadcn checkbox; see NOTICE.md for what changed.

items.name: ui-dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal dialog with a fixed close button. Kept as a kit item because it now differs from the upstream shadcn dialog, which offers a wider content API; see NOTICE.md for what changed.

items.name: ui-dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A menu triggered from a button or icon. Kept as a kit item because it now differs from the upstream shadcn dropdown menu, which offers a wider portal API; see NOTICE.md for what changed.

items.name: ui-empty
items.title: Empty state
items.description: A centred empty-state layout with a title, description and optional actions.

items.name: ui-input-group
items.title: Input group
items.description: Wraps an input or textarea with leading or trailing addons and buttons. Composes the ui-textarea item, not this kit's own Textarea from ui-input; see NOTICE.md.

items.name: ui-popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A floating panel anchored to a trigger. Kept as a kit item because it now differs from the upstream shadcn popover, which offers a keepMounted option; see NOTICE.md for what changed.

items.name: ui-select
items.title: Select
items.description: A single-choice select built on base-ui's select.

items.name: ui-sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A side panel dialog with a fixed close button. Kept as a kit item because it now differs from the upstream shadcn sheet, which offers a wider content API; see NOTICE.md for what changed.

items.name: ui-table
items.title: Table
items.description: A data table shell (table, header, body, row and cell) with the kit's own header and row styling. Kept as a kit item because it now differs from the upstream shadcn table; see NOTICE.md for what changed.

items.name: ui-tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A tab list and panels built on base-ui's tabs, with the kit's own inactive-tab colour. Kept as a kit item because it now differs from the upstream shadcn tabs; see NOTICE.md for what changed.

items.name: ui-alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline alert banner with default and destructive variants. Unmodified from the upstream shadcn alert; see NOTICE.md for provenance.

items.name: ui-alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: A modal dialog that interrupts the user for a required confirmation, built on base-ui's alert dialog. Unmodified from the upstream shadcn alert-dialog; see NOTICE.md for provenance.

items.name: ui-badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small status or count label with several colour variants, built on base-ui's render primitive. Unmodified from the upstream shadcn badge; see NOTICE.md for provenance.

items.name: ui-kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Renders a keyboard shortcut or key combination in a small pill. Unmodified from the upstream shadcn kbd; see NOTICE.md for provenance.

items.name: ui-label
items.title: Label
items.description: A form label wired to peer and group disabled states. Unmodified from the upstream shadcn label; see NOTICE.md for provenance.

items.name: ui-separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A horizontal or vertical divider line built on base-ui's separator. Unmodified from the upstream shadcn separator; see NOTICE.md for provenance.

items.name: ui-field
items.title: Field layout
items.description: Lays out a form field's label, description, error and control, singly or grouped in a fieldset. Unmodified from the upstream shadcn field; see NOTICE.md for provenance.

items.name: ui-textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text input matching the input's styling. Unmodified from the upstream shadcn textarea; see NOTICE.md for provenance.

items.name: ui-tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A hover or focus tooltip built on base-ui's tooltip, with a provider for shared delay. Unmodified from the upstream shadcn tooltip; see NOTICE.md for provenance.

items.name: field-renderers
items.title: Field renderers
items.description: Renders and edits a record field by its kind: text, number, date, boolean, enum, multi-enum, a repeatable group, or a raw JSON value read only. Provides the per-kind renderer map, the labelled controls, and the read-only value views, with a context to override or extend the kinds a project needs.

items.name: record-form
items.title: Record form
items.description: Renders a record's editable fields from its entity model, with a self-focusing validation error summary and handling for a field that is the record's sole required choice.

items.name: record-summary
items.title: Record facts
items.description: A definition list of a record's field values, read through the field renderers.

items.name: record-sections
items.title: Record sections
items.description: Groups a record's facts into the entity's own sections, each in its own card.

items.name: record-table
items.title: Record table
items.description: A table of records, one row per record and one column per field, each row linking through to the record.

items.name: record-list
items.title: Record cards and pager
items.description: A card list of records built from their facts, and a cursor-based pager for moving between pages of results.

items.name: record-filters
items.title: Record search form
items.description: A search input with submit and clear actions for filtering a list of records.

items.name: request-form
items.title: Request answers list
items.description: A read-only definition list of a request's answers.

items.name: request-status
items.title: Request command feedback
items.description: Renders the pending, unresolved, refused and confirmed states of a command run against a request, and a notice for an approved outcome the record has not yet applied.

items.name: request-recovery-notices
items.title: Request recovery notices
items.description: Warns when a request's review is cancelling, uncertain, or waiting on an operator, so the holder is not left assuming their review is proceeding normally.

items.name: request-review-notes
items.title: Request review notes
items.description: Shows the reviewer's notes to the request's holder, or that none have been left.

items.name: request-actions
items.title: Request decision form
items.description: Walks an officer through choosing one of a request's offered actions, checking it, and confirming it, with the focus and announcement each step needs. The caller supplies the actions, their reasons, and the submit and refetch behaviour.

items.name: request-changes
items.title: Change comparison tables
items.description: A three-column before-and-after table for reviewing proposed field changes, and a two-column comparison for a person to check their own proposal before it is sent.

items.name: request-attachment-slots
items.title: Attachment slots
items.description: Lists a record's governed attachment slots and their readiness, with one slot's upload, replace, remove and preview presentation. The caller supplies each slot's commands and this profile's authority over it.

items.name: request-verified-prefill
items.title: Verified prefill
items.description: Walks the consent, request and accept steps of asking a verified source for one field's answer, and a read-only summary of a field's verified evidence once a request is submitted.

items.name: casework-announce
items.title: Casework live announcer
items.description: One polite live region per page for sort, filter and row-count announcements, so screen reader users hear what a table change did.

items.name: casework-command-palette
items.title: Casework jump palette
items.description: A dialog holding one combobox that jumps to a work item, queue or page by typing, with every label taken from Casework content.

items.name: casework-content
items.title: Casework content provider
items.description: The words Casework blocks show on their own: generic defaults an app overrides from one place without editing block source.

items.name: casework-inbox
items.title: Casework inbox
items.description: The officer's own visible work: view tabs, a queue filter and one table of work items, with routing supplied by the host.

items.name: casework-item
items.title: Casework work item
items.description: The read-only rail, the trail, the private notes, the confirm step and the outcome of one Casework work item.

items.name: casework-items-table
items.title: Casework items table
items.description: The work-item table shared by the inbox and the team board: one row per item with state, due date and waiting time.

items.name: casework-review-context
items.title: Review context
items.description: What a reviewer reads before deciding: the task's subject and the context Casework recorded for it.

items.name: casework-review-decision
items.title: Review decision
items.description: A review task's decision form and the officer's own draft on it, with a confirm step before anything is sent.

items.name: casework-review-history
items.title: Review history
items.description: What has happened on a request and the clocks running against it, one entry per recorded event.

items.name: casework-review-notes
items.title: Review notes
items.description: Notes on a request for other reviewers or for the requester, read and written through the host's Casework routes.

items.name: casework-setup
items.title: Casework setup
items.description: A wizard that creates or changes a team, its staff, its leader and its queue, with a check step before anything is sent and a done step after.

items.name: casework-shared
items.title: Casework shared parts
items.description: State chips, warnings, loading and error chrome, and relative-time wording that every Casework block shares.

items.name: casework-shortcuts
items.title: Casework keyboard shortcuts
items.description: Single-key shortcuts for the work shell and the dialog that lists them; a key fires only while no field has focus.

items.name: casework-staffing
items.title: Casework staffing
items.description: Assigning and reassigning work, recording and ending an officer's absence, and moving their work, with every refusal shown in the host's words.

items.name: casework-subject
items.title: Review subject
items.description: What a reviewer sees of a task's subject: a BREG record's live fields, or the fields its display schema describes.

items.name: casework-task-grants
items.title: Casework agent tasks
items.description: The agent tasks on a Casework work item or a review task, with the controls an officer uses to preview and approve them.

items.name: casework-team
items.title: Casework team board
items.description: The supervisor's team board: the counts Casework sent for the page, each officer's load and the team's work items.

items.name: casework-work-shell
items.title: Casework work shell
items.description: The staff work shell: one dense header, a sidebar that is a plain list of links, the jump palette and the shortcuts.

items.name: documents-content
items.title: Documents content provider
items.description: The words the documents blocks show on their own: generic defaults an app overrides from one place without editing block source.

items.name: document-preview
items.title: Document preview
items.description: Opens one attachment version for reading: page navigation, zoom, rotation and page text for a document a caller has already decoded, with a bounded raster path for images. A PDF renderer is supplied by the caller; without one, a PDF shows the same refusal as any document that could not be opened.

items.name: shell-content
items.title: Shell content provider
items.description: Generic English defaults for the chrome around a session (header, sidebar, public pages, loading and error text), replaced with an app's own wording through a React context.

items.name: shell-routing
items.title: Hash routing
items.description: Reads and sets the current route from the URL's hash, and splits a route into its path and query string.

items.name: shell-page-heading
items.title: Page heading
items.description: The heading a page focuses on arrival, with an optional eyebrow, description and action, so hash navigation reads like a page load to assistive technology.

items.name: shell-back-link
items.title: Back link
items.description: A link back to an enclosing hash route, worded by the caller.

items.name: shell-loading
items.title: Loading indicator
items.description: A status region shown while a page waits on its data.

items.name: shell-empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: What a page shows in place of a list or a record that has nothing in it.

items.name: shell-status-badge
items.title: Status badge
items.description: A record or task's status, worded from the content model by its code, with a fallback for an unmapped one.

items.name: shell-live-announcer
items.title: Live announcer
items.description: One polite live region per page for sort, filter and row-count announcements.

items.name: shell-navigation
items.title: Navigation list
items.description: A flat list of places a session can reach, one link per item, with the current one marked for assistive technology.

items.name: shell-error-panel
items.title: Error panel
items.description: Words a failed read or write by its problem kind, with a support reference and an optional retry button.

items.name: shell-sign-out
items.title: Sign out
items.description: Ends the session and shows the host's own error if it fails.

items.name: shell-session-boundary
items.title: Session boundary
items.description: Shows loading, an error, the introduction or the protected page depending on the session's own state, and turns away the wrong audience.

items.name: shell-chrome
items.title: Signed-in shell
items.description: The signed-in chrome: a header with the brand and account, a sidebar for navigation, and the page, with an offline notice when the connection drops.

items.name: shell-public
items.title: Public shell
items.description: The chrome around a page shown before a session signs in.

items.name: shell-previous-submission-notice
items.title: Previous submission notice
items.description: Warns that an earlier submission from this device needs checking.

items.name: shell-login-failure
items.title: Login failure notice
items.description: Reads the sign-in redirect's own query string and words why sign-in did not complete.

items.name: shell-introduction
items.title: Introduction page
items.description: The public page a session sees before it signs in, with a sign-in link scoped to its audience.

items.name: shell-help-page
items.title: Help page
items.description: Renders the help body, support reference and recovery guidance from the content model.

items.name: shell-work-frame
items.title: Work frame
items.description: Resolves a route to its current place and wires the staff work shell's navigation and sign-out error to hash routing.

items.name: pages-register-routes
items.title: Register routes
items.description: Where a register's record and request pages live: one provider an app sets its own paths in, so page blocks link to records and requests without naming a path themselves.

items.name: lib-queue-parts
items.title: Queue filter, table and pager parts
items.description: The filter bar, filter chips, result count, table and pager a cursor-paged queue composes itself from.

items.name: lib-tab-memory
items.title: Tab-scoped cursor memory
items.description: The cursor stack behind a paged list's Previous button, held in this browser tab so a route remount never loses it.

items.name: lib-list-memory
items.title: Opened-from list memory
items.description: The list an item was opened from, held in this browser tab so its page can offer previous and next.

items.name: pages-casework-staffing
items.title: Casework staffing page
items.description: Assigning, reassigning, absence cover and moving work, wired to this app's own route so a pending write can link back to the item it belongs to.

items.name: pages-casework-setup
items.title: Casework setup page
items.description: The administrator's one-time bootstrap of a team, its people and its queue, wired to this app's own error chrome.

items.name: pages-casework-inbox-content
items.title: Casework inbox page content
items.description: The words the Casework inbox page shows on its own: the view tabs, the queue filter, the empty states and the next-item action.

items.name: pages-casework-inbox
items.title: Casework inbox page
items.description: The officer's own visible work: view tabs, a queue chip and one table, wired to this app's own route, register routes and shortcuts.

items.name: pages-casework-holdings
items.title: Casework holdings page
items.description: The supervisor's team board: who holds what, their absence cover, and the team's items, which can be selected and reassigned together, wired to this app's own route.

items.name: pages-casework-review-content
items.title: Casework review page content
items.description: The words the Casework review pages show on their own: the queue table and the task's status line and hold controls.

items.name: pages-casework-review
items.title: Casework review pages
items.description: The review queue this officer's Casework profile can see, and a review task's context, hold, decision, draft, notes, history and clocks, wired to this app's own routes.

items.name: pages-casework-item-content
items.title: Casework item page content
items.description: The words the casework item page shows on its own: back link and position in a list, pager, hold and assign wording, the why-asked and history headings, and the notice shown while an earlier action is still settling.

items.name: pages-casework-item
items.title: Casework item page
items.description: One casework item: what is proposed against the record it targets and why, its supporting documents, hold, assign and decide controls, private notes and history, wired to this app's own route, register routes and shortcuts.

items.name: pages-content
items.title: Pages content provider
items.description: Generic English defaults for a register's record and request pages: lists, detail, creating a record, the change request form and its recovery notices, replaced with an app's own wording through a React context.

items.name: pages-record
items.title: Record model helpers
items.description: Reads a session model's record and request entities, the fields a request writes and what they hold now, checks a proposed change's answers against the registry's rules, and shows the unresolved write and unavailable-write notices a record or request page needs.

items.name: pages-task-feedback
items.title: Task feedback
items.description: A record or request command's outcome: sending, an unconfirmed result with its retry, a refusal, or a confirmed receipt with a link to what it created.

items.name: pages-record-list
items.title: Record list page
items.description: The records of the register's record entity: cards for a holder, a table for staff, with search, a create action and cursor paging.

items.name: pages-record-detail
items.title: Record detail page
items.description: One record of the register's record entity: its sections, a change action, its revision history and the requests already made on it.

items.name: pages-create-record
items.title: Create record page
items.description: A register record, created with the create action the record list offers this session.

items.name: pages-record-attachments
items.title: Record attachments
items.description: A record's governed attachment slots: upload, replace, remove and an on-demand preview, plus the notice of this session's uploads still waiting to be confirmed.

items.name: pages-change-request-form
items.title: Change request form page
items.description: A request to change one register record: a create from the record it changes, or the edit of a saved draft, with a checking step, verified prefill and the write's own task feedback.

items.name: pages-request-detail
items.title: Request detail page
items.description: One request against the register: its proposed change compared to the record it targets, why it was asked, its supporting documents, and the decision or lifecycle action open to this session.

items.name: styles
items.title: App stylesheet
items.description: The Tailwind entry point every block in this kit is built against: design tokens, layout rules for the work shell and casework screens, and the document preview chrome. Files of this type are placed verbatim at a fixed path rather than merged through an alias, since a stylesheet does not belong under the components, lib, ui or hooks aliases the rest of this registry uses.
items.docs: Import this from your project's own global stylesheet, adjusting the relative path to where it lands, for example `@import "./styles/registrystack-app-blocks/styles.css";`. Then edit its `@source` lines: they describe this kit's own repository layout, not yours.

items.name: pages-request-queue
items.title: Request queue page
items.description: The requests against the register's request entity: a holder's own requests, or the full queue a reviewer or other staff role sees, filterable by stage and cursor-paged.

items.name: pages-default-tasks
items.title: Default task hooks
items.description: The create, change and decision tasks and the attachment upload and removal commands the page blocks submit with: `@registrystack/app-runtime`'s own hooks, each attempt handed on as `reference`. The request attachment commands aim at the request the current route names.

items.name: pages-default-notices
items.title: Default write notices
items.description: The notices of this session's unresolved submission and unresolved uploads, over the record and attachment blocks' own notices and `@registrystack/app-runtime`'s recovery and pending-upload hooks, each attempt handed on as `reference`.

items.name: pages-default-casework
items.title: Default Casework bindings
items.description: Casework's inbox, item and Team pages bound to generic wording: each item's task named by the request label the session model gives it unless the app words it, the apply effect and state sentences from the item page's content, and the default attachment commands. Also the notice that leads an officer back to an item whose action was not confirmed, from any page but that item's own.

items.name: pages-service-app
items.title: Service app
items.description: The holder-facing composition of a register's public service: introduction, session boundary, public help, the register's own records and requests. It takes no register nouns of its own; `useRegisterRoutes()` supplies the paths, the model's plural labels name the nav places, and the task, upload and removal hooks and the notices are the default ones. A caller may pass its own nav labels, hooks and notices in their place.

items.name: pages-staff-app
items.title: Staff app
items.description: The officer-facing composition of a register's staff work: the work shell's places, the register's own records and requests, and Casework's inbox, item, holdings, setup, reviews and review pages. It takes no register nouns of its own; `useRegisterRoutes()` supplies the paths, the model's plural labels name the nav places, and the task, upload and removal hooks, the notices and the inbox, item and holdings pages are the default ones. A caller may pass its own nav labels, task heading, hooks, notices and bound Casework pages in their place.
